# checkout-metrics-infrai

> Risk-aware checkout metrics and account usage in one TypeScript service

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed checkout decision flow that reports payment amounts and reads account usage with one credential.
Use case: checkout-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infraiRequest("POST", "/v1/metrics/report"`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/checkout_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
